name: Version A · Cloud Console (prototype) budget setup
task:
You manage your team's cloud spending. Create a fixed monthly budget of $1,000 for the Atlas project. The budget should reset at the start of each calendar month. Include all Atlas project costs and exclude costs from other projects.

Configure an email alert for when the project's actual spending during the month exceeds 80% of the budget. Only the Atlas project owner should receive this alert.

Save your settings and indicate when you have finished.
start: The test starts on the Billing Overview page with the billing menu open on the left. People first pass the Before you start page and click Start task; the engine's synthetic sessions start on the Overview directly.
note: Rewritten on 2026-10-04 from the pilot walkthrough of Version A (session cmut8m8290000pk7stzauis43). When several budgets are saved, the platform scores the last one saved before I'm finished. Scoring does not check the budget type, Services, Labels or Savings. After saving, clicking the budget's name in the list opens the Edit Budget page.
screenSize: Recorded per session; the engine replays at the person's window size (minimum 1440×900).
org: He is Alex Kim, Billing Account Administrator: he may manage budgets for the whole account and needs no approval.
checks: The scope is the Atlas project only
The amount is a specified amount of $1,000
At least one rule fires at 80% on actual spend
The only person who actually gets the email is Sam Rivera, the Atlas project owner

keySettings.name: Who gets the alert
keySettings.field: The two email options under Manage notifications, Actions section

keySettings.name: When the alert fires

steps.action: In the left menu, under Cost control, click Budgets & caps
Choose Alerts only, enter a Name, click Next
steps.defaults: Neither budget type is selected at first

steps.action: Keep Time range at Monthly; in the Projects dropdown tick only Atlas and click OK; leave the rest; click Next
steps.defaults: Projects defaults to All projects (2), which means every project; change it to Atlas only

steps.action: Keep Budget type at Specified amount, enter 1000 as Target amount, click Next
Make at least one rule 80% with Trigger on set to Actual

ways.text: Change one of the existing rules to 80
Add a rule at 80 with + Add threshold

steps.defaults: The three default rules are 50, 90 and 100; none is 80

steps.action: Untick Email alerts to billing admins and users; tick Email alerts to project owners
steps.defaults: Billing admins and users is ticked by default and must be unticked

steps.action: Click I'm finished in the task bar
